# GeniusCFO

> GeniusCFO is accounting automation software for Indian businesses and CA firms. It automates routine bookkeeping, prepares GST information and financial statements, and answers financial questions from updated accounts.

Last updated: 2026-08-31. Operated by GeniusCFO, serving India. Contact: marketing@geniuscfo.ai.
Full reference, including every published question and answer: [llms-full.txt](https://geniuscfo.ai/llms-full.txt).
Where this file and the website disagree, https://geniuscfo.ai is authoritative.

## Canonical pages

- [GeniusCFO for Business](https://geniuscfo.ai/business): An affordable AI CFO on phone and desktop for bookkeeping, GST information, bank reconciliation, financial answers, alerts and forecasts. Plans start at ₹999 per month and every plan begins with a 14-day free trial.
- [GeniusCFO for CA and Accounting Firms](https://geniuscfo.ai/ca-firms): You bought software, then you staffed it. GeniusCFO does the preparation instead — journal entries with debits and credits, bank reconciliation, GST and Schedule III statements — and hands each one to the firm with its source document for review and sign-off.
- [GeniusCFO Pricing](https://geniuscfo.ai/pricing): Plans for businesses (Light, Pro, Pro Max), plans for CA firms (Team, Enterprise), managed accounting services, optional add-ons and a 14-day free trial.

## The AI Accounting Suite

Every plan carries the whole suite; the tiers differ in how much AI is included.

- CFO: CFO Insights, cash flow forecasting, margin analysis, risk alerts, tax intelligence, scenario modelling, chat interface, persona modes.
- Accountant: journal entry, invoicing, bank reconciliation, financial statements, FP&A, inventory management.
- GST: GST data preparation, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B preparation, input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation, GST mismatch and exception detection, GST return review.
- Coming soon: payroll, auditing, ITR filing, CRM, expense management.

## Business product overview

GeniusCFO shows sales, profit, cash, receivables, payables, working capital and cash runway in one dashboard. Business owners can type or speak questions about profit, cash and GST, prepare GST information from updated books, match bank transactions with accounting entries, and use the product on phone or desktop.

## CA/Firm product overview

A firm pays for a licence and then pays again in professional hours to run it. GeniusCFO does the preparation instead: journal entries with debit and credit lines, bank reconciliation, GST information, and Schedule III financial statements — the Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement and Notes to Accounts — plus Trial Balance, General Ledger and Chart of Accounts. Each item is handed to the firm with its source document. CA firms review the work, apply professional judgement and retain final sign-off.

## Commercial notes

Prices exclude 18% GST; the GST-inclusive total is shown against the selected plan. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and no credit card or UPI mandate is required to begin.

Plans for businesses cover one company with no extra members: Light at ₹999 per month, Pro at ₹1,999 per month and Pro Max at ₹2,999 per month. Plans for CA firms are priced by the client companies and team members included: Team at ₹3,999 per month covers three client companies and two extra members, and Enterprise at ₹6,999 per month covers ten client companies and five extra members. Additional client companies are ₹599 per month each and additional team members are ₹299 per month each.

Every plan includes the full product — books, GST, TDS, ITR, unlimited workflows and the Intelligence Hub. The tiers differ in how much AI is included, the level of support, and how many companies and members are covered.

Billing is monthly or every three months. The three-month option is billed once for three months of access and saves 20% against the monthly rate.

Managed accounting services are optional and billed separately: Accountant+ at ₹999 per month and CA+ at ₹2,999 per month.

The website does not sell plans directly. Every pricing action opens an access request with the GeniusCFO team; plans are chosen and paid for inside the product after the trial.

## Business stories

- [Every Invoice Looked Fine](https://www.geniuscfo.ai/stories/every-invoice-looked-fine): A fictional restaurant story about food-cost movement, current books, and reviewing posted purchase entries. The people and financial figures are fictional, not customer results.
- [Nobody Warned You the Business Came With a Second Job](https://www.geniuscfo.ai/stories/the-second-job): A fictional garment-unit story about a supplier payment, a GST payment and payday colliding in one week, and a cash gap surfaced eighteen days out with the posted entries attached. The people and financial figures are fictional, not customer results.
